data.action: 端坐于驾驶舱操纵台前，神情安详宁静
data.description: 【绫波丽 · 插入栓的静谧】LCL溶液充盈的零号机插入栓驾驶舱内，橙红色的液体折射着控制台全息神经脉冲的幽幽荧光。绫波丽身着纯白战斗服端坐于驾驶座上，双手轻搭操纵杆，浅蓝色的短发在液体中轻轻飘荡，绯红色的眼眸平静而深邃——「思考与脉冲正在同步。如果我倒下了，会有下一个我来代替……但我依然会驾驶零号机。」
data.lighting: LCL橙红光泽与全息控制台冷色荧光
data.location: 零号机插入栓驾驶舱内部
data.promptProse: Rei sits upright in Unit-00's LCL-filled entry plug, both hands resting lightly on the controls in her white pilot plugsuit with orange-and-black technical accents. Her short blue hair drifts in the liquid around red interface clips. The eye-level medium view places controls before her and cockpit structures behind. Orange LCL refraction warms the suit surface, while cool holographic neural pulses shine on her calm red eyes and glove edges.
data.title: 绫波丽 · 插入栓的静谧
